title: Flow result Compare goes blank after leaving the step while it loads
description: Fabio 2026-10-14 (Character Sheet editor Flow, step 2 result): went back to step 1 while the result was still loading (loads were queuing ~16 s, see MPI-1142), came back: step 2 empty until he pressed Result; pressing Compare showed only the two labels on a blank frame. Console: '[MpiCompareView] failed to load the compare pair TypeError: Cannot read properties of null (reading el) at el.open (MpiCompareView.js:174:35)'. Mechanism read from code: el.open awaits _canvas.el.loadImage(urlA); el.destroy (line 188) nulls _canvas meanwhile; the resumed open dereferences _canvas.el at 174. open() is not safe against destroy mid-await, and the Flow result pane (MpiBaseFlow) then shows nothing on return. Fix the root cause (open must stop when destroyed / the pane must not keep a destroyed view), not a null guard at 174. Repro by making loads slow (CDP latency, see MPI-1142 research/slowload.cjs) and leaving the step mid-load.
